content.text:
## Plan: canvas-theme-editor further refinements

Package: `packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/`. "Guide" mode = iframe-embedded (docs pages, no shell). "Tool" mode = direct top-level navigation to `/tools/canvas-rce/` (adds the `#canvas-rce-shell` header with interface-theme menu, only when `window.self === window.top`).

**Key finding tying items 1 & 4 together:** `PREVIEW_SCHEME_FORCE_CSS` in [main.ts.tmpl](packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts.tmpl#L199) re-derives lightningcss's downleveled `light-dark()` vars from `data-pantoken-scheme` — but it's only applied to the TinyMCE editor content and preview iframe, **never** to `chromeThemeStyle` (the chrome's own button/text tokens). That's why explicitly picking a scheme only moves the background while buttons/text keep following the OS preference — and why it's worse once the preview pane (and its device buttons) get physically moved into a separate popup window.

**Steps**

**Phase A — Chrome scheme forcing** (fixes 1 & 4): append the scheme-forcing CSS to `chromeThemeStyle` inside `applyChromeTheme()`; verify the popup's stylesheet-cloning loop picks it up.

**Phase B — Investigate blank space** (fixes 2): live-repro first in the browser — `.content` is flex and the pane is truly removed from the DOM, so static analysis didn't pin the cause (stale outer iframe height message vs. a `.content`/`.pane` CSS retention). Fix based on findings.

**Phase C — Layout toggle** (fixes 3 & 6): add missing `layoutDirectionLabel` i18n key; fix the row-default-but-icon-says-row-when-actually-column mismatch (default to row, not column, when no localStorage); disable the toggle in `openPreviewPopup()`, re-enable in `restorePreviewFromPopup()`.

**Phase D — Tray forced dark** (fixes 5): extend the existing `resetSelector: "#theme-tray, #canvas-rce-shell"` color-isolation pattern with a scheme-only reset scoped to `#theme-tray` alone (not the shell header, which should keep following interface theme per item 4).

**Phase E — Dock icon** (fixes 7): reuse the already-existing `icon-reversed.svg` asset to build a dark PNG set in `canvas-rce-pwa.ts`, wired up via `<link rel="icon" media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)">` so Safari's "Add to Dock" (which reads live `<link>` icons, not the manifest) auto-picks the contrasting variant.

**Relevant files:** `main.ts.tmpl`, `app.html`, `app.css`, `i18n.json` (all in the scaffold template), `docs/scripts/canvas-rce-pwa.ts`, and possibly `canvas-rce-iframe-height.js`/`CanvasRcePage.vue` depending on Phase B's findings.

**Decisions** (confirmed with you): bundle the i18n fix into item 6; dock icon uses media-query dual icon links from the existing reversed asset; item 2 starts with live investigation before a fix is chosen.

Full detail is saved in `/memories/session/plan.md`. Let me know if you'd like any changes, or you can proceed to implementation.
